description:
Finds seminars in the IT-Schulungen.com catalogue.

Use this first when a topic is known but the seminar identifier is not.
The search is semantic and covers the whole seminar text, so describe the
goal in the customer's own words -- "wie sichere ich unsere
Container-Umgebung ab" finds Docker and Kubernetes security seminars that
share no word with the question. A keyword list works worse than a
sentence. Results come back by relevance.

Two operators exist: a phrase in double quotes, and a term prefixed with
a minus sign to exclude it. Either one turns the search back into a
keyword match, so use them only to correct a search that went wide.

Each record carries `topics`, the subjects the seminar is tagged with --
use them to say why a seminar fits and to tell close candidates apart.

Each record also carries `prices`, one per delivery form: the amount and
what it is per, nothing more. What is included and what costs extra --
an exam voucher, catering on site -- comes only from `seminar_get`, so
call it before stating what a seminar costs in total; until then say
"from". All amounts are net, plus VAT. When the
delivery form is not known, lead with the open seminar, priced per
participant; name the in-house price per day only when a team or company
is asking or there is no open seminar, and coaching or a subscription
only when asked. A price without an amount is price on request, and so
is a seminar without `prices`.

Returns a compact record per seminar, each with `url`: the page on
IT-Schulungen.com. Enquiries and bookings do not run through this server,
so that link is where a customer has to go -- name it whenever a seminar
is recommended, exactly as returned: its query string is part of the
link. Call `seminar_get` with a `guid` from this list for the
agenda and prerequisites, and `seminar_dates` for scheduled dates.

query.description: What the seminar should be about, at least 2 characters

topic.description: Exact topic name or identifier from `seminar_topics`

name: seminars_search
title: Search seminars
